drafts.message: Hi Northwind team, I'm with Acme Agents (fictional). Your integrations page lists 12 tool partners and invites new ones. Our memory API is used by agent builders, a lot like yours. A native integration plus a short joint guide could help both sets of users. Open to a 20-minute call to see if it fits?

drafts.subject: Acme x Northwind integration
drafts.message: Following up on my note about an Acme memory integration for Northwind users. Happy to send a one-page outline first if that's easier.
